startup.$comment: Cold-process `import('./dist/index.js')` wall time. Baseline ~37ms; the ceiling is a non-flaky sanity bound that catches catastrophic startup regression, not a tight per-machine target. Plan 071 Task 3: the in-chain gate asserts the machine-relative ratio importMs/processStartMs (denominator = median empty `node -e ""` process start on the same machine in the same run) because external CPU load inflates both numbers together (calibrated 2026-09-12 on 16 CPUs: ratio 3.3 idle at import 58-63ms/process 17-19ms; 3.45-4.05 with a full `npm test` running concurrently; up to 7.2 with 40 competing processes, where the absolute import spiked to 258ms). Off load the tight ratio ceiling (8) and this absolute ceiling are asserted; under load (loadavg-per-CPU >= 1.5) importRatioCeilingUnderLoad (20) replaces the tight ceiling and the absolute bound becomes evidence-of-record in scripts/benchmark.mjs.

benchmarkMedians.$comment: Network-free scenario medians measured by the pre-0.1.3 per-version runners (0.0.15, 100 iterations; reused unchanged by 0.0.16 — 0.0.16 added no performance-affecting code; both consolidated into scripts/benchmark.mjs in plan 015 Task 1). Throughput regression = measured < baseline*(1-tolerance); latency regression = measured > baseline*(1+tolerance).
